title: Bob's tools, skills, subagents and mode shown as each soldier's loadout

outcome: The unit profile shows two fixed slots, DECLARE STEP and HOLD THE LINE, whatever Bob does.
The session-start event lists every skill defined in the watched repo's .bob/skills, by name and description.
forbid: no file reads in the hook path — the roster is read once at start_session, never per hook (invariant 1)
a missing or malformed .bob/skills yields an empty roster, never a failed start_session

outcome: Each soldier's weapons show how many tool calls Bob made in each class: recon, search, edit, command, radio.
forbid: no stat that no event backs — every number counts real hook events
leave app.ts, mission-screen.ts, panels.ts, index.html, art-urls.ts and audio.ts alone — they carry the developer's uncommitted work

outcome: A skill Bob loads with use_skill shows as learned on its soldier until the next compaction; defined skills not yet loaded show as locked.
Each Bob subagent shows on its soldier with its preset, its task and whether it is running or done.
forbid: calls made while several subagents run are never credited to one of them — Bob gives no agent marker

outcome: The soldier's class shows the mode Bob last switched to with switch_mode.

evidence: start_session pushes session{on, skills} from definedSkills(cwd) (engine/src/skills.ts); reads only at start, [] on missing/malformed dir; skills.test.ts covers frontmatter, empty repo and the pushed event

view.loadout.shots counts PostToolUse calls per weapon class (scope/radar/rifle/explosives/radio); unit profile renders them via loadout-view.ts; loadout.test.ts; untouched: app.ts, mission-screen.ts, panels.ts, index.html, art-urls.ts, audio.ts
use_skill PostToolUse adds to loadout.learned, PostCompact clears it; lockedSkills shows defined-but-unloaded; tested

spawn_subagent PreToolUse now forwarded to the page (squad.shownOnPage); subagent shows preset/task/RUNNING|DONE|NO RESULT; calls credited only when it runs alone, else sharedCalls; Stop closes unreturned ones; tested
switch_mode PostToolUse sets loadout.mode, shown as CLASS on the unit profile; STARTING MODE until Bob switches (hooks don't carry the start mode)

disposition: Shipped: Bob's tools as weapons, skills learned/locked, subagents as squadmates and mode as class on the unit profile. Browser pass skipped (BROWSER_VERIFY_SKILL empty). No doc edit: only an optional SSE field was added, none of the four data contracts changed.
